turns.text: how do I link care contexts once I have the link token
Call POST /api/hiecm/hip/v3/link/carecontext with the patient's care contexts, sending the link token in the X-LINK-TOKEN header.
can i send more than one visit

must_contain: One call can link one or many care contexts: put them in the careContexts array and set count to how many there are.
hiTypes on each patient entry is one value, such as OPConsultation, not an array.
notes: The last turn is under specified: 'visit' means care context on the link call from the assistant turn.
